title: Lanternmoss Mire
summary: A 16x16 tile and sprite asset pack for a bog (tiles, a bog-ferrier hero, six creatures, items, props), shown as its 320x192 map: A by day, B the same tiles at night, glowing.
request: No verbatim user request is recorded for this piece. The brief (brief.md section 0) states: "assets (guides/assets.md) ... 16x16 tiles; hero 16x24 ... creatures 12-20 px; items 7-12 px", a 3/4 top-down game screen, day and glowing night palettes, a 320x192 map at 4x, and a 5.0 s SFX reel (examples/moments/README.md: "A: the asset pack's map by day. B: the same tiles at night, glowing.").

outputs.name: sample
outputs.run: python3 sound/sfx_reel.py && ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i sound/09-sample.wav -codec:a libmp3lame -q:a 2 sound/09-sample.mp3

anatomy.draws: The asset-pack brief: grid, camera, delivery, palette roles day and night, sprite plans, sound plan
Pack manifest for pixelate assets: name, day and night palettes, scale
Day palette (38 slots plus ol and wh)
Glowing night palette with identical slot names
Generated tiles: moss-on-peat corner autotiles, peat bank over water, bog water frames, boardwalk
The bog-ferrier hero, 16x24, front, back and side frames with walk and idle cycles
Six mire creatures: heron, toad, moth, crab, eel, snail, with idle animations
Shared helpers: stamping typed slot maps, moving parts between frames, hashing
Hand-drawn item sprites in the .px format
Hand-drawn prop sprites in the .px format
The 20x12 tile map: corner grid, deck grid and props
Composes the map as palette slots once and paints it with the day and night palettes (out/09-a, out/09-b, optional GIFs)
Synthesises a 5.0 s chip SFX reel and item-get jingle with emulated pulse, wave and noise channels

provenance.by: parallel Claude agents with a coordinating agent as art director (examples/moments showcase run, PR #21); migrated to library/ on 2026-10-18 without re-review
